title: Miragon BPMN Modeler deployment targets
description: Named, team-shareable deployment connections. Secrets are never stored here.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema for editors without a registered mapping.

endpoint.description: Base URL of the Camunda REST API. May contain ${env:VAR} references, resolved at request time from a workspace-root .env file or the process environment.

tenantId.description: Optional tenant identifier. May contain ${env:VAR} references.

tokenEndpoint.description: OAuth2 token endpoint (oauth2 only). May contain ${env:VAR} references.

audience.description: OAuth2 audience (oauth2 only). May contain ${env:VAR} references.

username.description: Basic-auth username as an environment reference (${env:VAR}) only — never a literal secret. Resolved at request time.

password.description: Basic-auth password as an environment reference (${env:VAR}) only — never a literal secret. Resolved at request time.

clientId.description: OAuth2 client ID as an environment reference (${env:VAR}) only — never a literal secret. Resolved at request time.

clientSecret.description: OAuth2 client secret as an environment reference (${env:VAR}) only — never a literal secret. Resolved at request time.

endpoints.description: Optional full-URL overrides for gateways with custom routes.

deploy.description: Full URL for the deploy call. May contain ${env:VAR} references.

startInstance.description: Full URL for start-instance; {processDefinitionKey} is substituted. May contain ${env:VAR} references.
